notes.title: Graphical, audio, gameplay updates and Open XR support
notes.content:
We're preparing some major updates! This is the preamble to good things to come as we 


 Updated graphics for better looking humans
 More clothing options for your avatars
 Re-recorded audio to elminate reverb of the original recordings
 Better movement, gameplay, and input support
 Nicer looking atmosphere
 OpenXR support to be compatible with multiple VR headsets


Big announcements coming your way soon!
